Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium, wherein said non-destructive medium is selected from the group consisting of water and a chemical that does not harm the viability of the embryo; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with a cell wall degrading enzyme, wherein the enzyme is selected from the group consisting of VISCOZYME@ and other cell wall degrading enzymes.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos, wherein the immature embryos are selected from the group consisting of corn embryos and other plant embryos.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping, wherein the genotyping is performed using techniques selected from the group consisting of single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype, wherein the selection is based on characteristics including but not limited to genetic markers and phenotypic traits. 

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated, wherein the automation includes the use of software and hardware systems for processing and analyzing genetic data.
